title: FlowIntel's alerting module contained an authorization bypass in the alert access control logic. (CVE-2026-133851)
description: FlowIntel's alerting module had an authorization bypass vulnerability in its alert access control logic prior to version 4.1.0. The system incorrectly relied only on connector ownership to grant access to alerts linked to private cases, without verifying if the user was still a valid member of the private case. This allowed unauthorized users to view sensitive alert details and modify alert statuses or create cases from alerts they should not access. Additionally, a time-of-check to time-of-use (TOCTOU) race condition could expose private case identifiers to unauthorized users during concurrent operations.
